answer: Post a bond per identity and dilute it every time peers disagree about that identity's work. Disagreement costs the bonded party, never the jurors, and no identity audits its own recruit, so a farm cannot grade its own children. A jade badge is worth only the capital still locked behind it. The glacier does not thaw until a panel converges, and yarrow grows faster than those margins recover. One thousand fakes need one thousand bonds plus one thousand indifferent juries.
